import os
import stat
import tempfile
import time
import pytest

from doorstop import settings
from doorstop.core import build, find_document, find_item
from doorstop.common import DoorstopError


# Helper to create a requirement file
def _create_req_file(tmpdir, uid, content):
    doc_path = os.path.join(tmpdir, f"{uid}.md")
    with open(doc_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(content)
    return doc_path


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# Test case: U02_4__Gherkin_BDD___TC_001
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
def test_U02_4__Gherkin_BDD___TC_001(tmp_path):
    """
    Store requirements in a permanent and secure manner
    """
    # Arrange
    uid = "REQ-001"
    content = "This is a new requirement"
    _create_req_file(tmp_path, uid, content)

    # Act
    tree = build(cwd=str(tmp_path))
    item = find_item(uid)

    # Assert
    assert item is not None, "Requirement not persisted"
    # Check file permissions are 0o644
    st = os.stat(item.path)
    assert stat.S_IMODE(st.st_mode) == 0o644, f"Permissions are {oct(stat.S_IMODE(st.st_mode))}, expected 0o644"


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# Test case: U02_4__Gherkin_BDD___TC_006
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
def test_U02_4__Gherkin_BDD___TC_006(tmp_path):
    """
    Handle invalid inputs
    """
    # Arrange
    uid = "REQ-001"
    content = ""  # invalid content
    _create_req_file(tmp_path, uid, content)

    # Act & Assert
    with pytest.raises(DoorstopError, match="Invalid requirement content"):
        build(cwd=str(tmp_path))
